title: Family Tides | Updated 30A Retreat | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Family Tides is a luxury 30A retreat with a private carriage house, golf cart, bikes, screened porch, and quick access to the beach, pool, and dining.
description_expanded: Ultimate Beach Getaway - 0.5 miles to the Gulf, Steps from the Pool! Welcome to Family Tides (formerly known as Pelican Pines), where luxury meets relaxation in the heart of 30A! This stunning beach retreat is designed for unforgettable family vacations, offering a spacious main home plus a private carriage house, just a 0.5 mile bike or golf cart ride to the beach! Why You'll Love It Here : - Prime Location - Steps from the community pool with beach access just minutes away! - 6-Seater LSV and 5 Taxi Bikes included with your reservation - Cruise to the beach, shops, and top dining spots in style! - Huge Screened Porch with TV - Perfect for relaxing mornings and cozy evenings. - Outdoor Living at Its Best - Fire pit, gas grill, outdoor shower, and lush backyard views. - Private Carriage House - Complete with a kitchen, laundry, and king suite for extra privacy! Room to Sleep 14 Guests Comfortably! Main House : - 3 Luxurious King Suites (including 1 on the first floor!) Bunk Room for 4 - Built-in twin-over-twin bunks for the little adventurers! - Bonus Den and Kids' Landing Area with TV - Extra space to spread out and unwind. - Gourmet Kitchen and Spacious Dining Area - Incredible private outdoor spaces including a screened-in patio with outdoor dining and a spacious landscaped backyard with grill, Cornhole, and multiple seating areas Carriage House: - Private King Suite, Full Kitchen, Laundry, and Living Area with sleeper sofa - Perfect for extra guests who desire a little extra privacy! Endless Fun Just Minutes Away! - 2-Min Bike Ride - Shops, Restaurants and Markets (Old Florida Fish House, Beachy Bean Coffee and more!) - 4-Min Ride - Greenway Station (Live music, shopping, yoga and more!) - 4-Min Ride - The Big Chill (Game nights, family events, movie nights and live entertainment!) - Public Park Access to Eastern Lake - Enjoy kayaking, paddle boarding and YOLO boards! Know Before You Go - A mid-stay clean is required for bookings 10+ days (included in rate) - Concierge services available for add-ons like eBikes, beach bonfires, beach chair and umbrella setup, and chef services - Driveway parking for 2 vehicles available. Street, RV, or trailer parking is restricted by the HOA - YouTube TV (provides local channels and live programming), Smart TVs and WIFI throughout home - There is a security camera at the front entrance of the home This isn't just a beach house-it's a beach experience! Whether you're looking for a relaxing retreat or an adventure-filled escape, Family Tides has it all. Book now and start making unforgettable beach memories!
